newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian shares close mixed, conglomerates rise.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian shares close mixed, conglomerates rise.

text.p: Strong demand for shares in some of Nigeria's largest conglomerates pushed their share prices higher in Thursday trading, dealers said.
However the stock exchange said the all-share index dropped marginally to 8699.71 against 8699.73 on Wednesday.
United African Company rose 88 kobo to close at 18.45 naira. Coca-Cola bottlers Nigerian Bottling Company gained 50 kobo to 54.00 naira.
Union Dicon Salt and Lever Brothers both finished 40 kobo higher at 50.40 naira and 28.50 naira respectively.
PZ Industries and tyre makers Dunlop both firmed by 15 kobo to close at 28.50 naira and 14.00 naira respectively.
Wema Bank, Royal Exchange Assurance and Impresit Bakolori all added 10 kobo to close at 2.10 naira, 4.00 naira and 4.76 naira respectively.
Footwear makers Lennards fell two kobo to 0.82 naira.
